question_evidence_quote: Randy had 32 biscuits. His father gave him 13 biscuits as a gift. His mother gave him 15 biscuits. Randy’s brother ate 20 of these biscuits.
observed_error: The response reports 30 as the result of the correctly written expression (32 + 13 + 15) - 20.
violated_condition: The remaining count must equal the initial 32 biscuits plus gifts of 13 and 15, minus the 20 eaten.
error_description: The response correctly adds the initial 32 biscuits and gifts of 13 and 15, then subtracts the 20 eaten, but reports 30 biscuits. That result does not equal its written expression; the observable mistake is in the numerical evaluation.
uncertainty_note: The text does not show which intermediate arithmetic operation produced the incorrect result.
